title: Mi Ruby Pantera
lyrics:
be bop pop bot sneaky phonk panthera vibe ride, pouncy punky puma side by side, ruby bo boo B B B or B ruby roo roo roos kanga kangaroo didgerdoo soul crawl, father-daughter duet warm male vocals Corey sweet young female vocals Ruby trading lines and harmonizing on every chorus with call and response, G4 swagger joyful confidence playful empowering bouncy energy, Spanish lick in bridge "¡Mi Ruby mi gemita pantera pouncy G4!" with natural melodic Latin flavor, upbeat positive family anthem full of love and celebration, bebop jazz scat fused with sneaky phonk grooves sleek panthera synth bass and leads, energetic punky pouncy drums with cute bouncy feel, kangaroo hopping rhythms throughout verses, deep resonant didgeridoo soul drone in bridges and breakdowns for emotional depth, 336 Hz resonant foundation, sweet adoring male vocals with bouncy playful delivery and ad-libs, sweet energetic young daughter vocals with joyful bounce and harmony layers, high quality production emotional depth family bonding joyful celebration bouncy groovy resonant low end crisp clear vocals distinct duet separation

[Intro - Extended Scat & Vibe Ride]
Be bop pop bot sneaky phonk panthera vibe ride
Pouncy punky puma side by side
Ruby bo boo B B B or B
Ruby roo roo roos kanga kangaroo didgerdoo soul crawl
Be bop pop bot feel the phonk in the air
Panthera grace pouncy puma everywhere
Ruby bo boo B B B or B
Ruby roo roo roos bounce with me
Sneaky but sweet G4 energy rising
Kanga kangaroo hopping surprising
Didgeridoo calling from deep in the soul
Panthera pouncy making the whole family whole
Be bop pop bot let the vibe ride begin
Pouncy punky puma side by side we win

[Verse 1 - Corey]
Ruby you're the GEM G Gemini shining so bright
A precious Gem just like Jemma pure light
Sneaky panthera grace when you move through the room
Pouncy little puma you light up the gloom
Bouncing through life with that G4 swagger groove
Stealing every show with your playful move
Ruby bo boo you are my joy and my pride
Side by side forever on this beautiful ride
Your Gemini sparkle double the light you bring
Pouncy punky puma hear the whole family sing

[Verse 1.5 - Ruby Response]
Daddy I feel the G4 in my step so free
Bouncing like kanga no one does it like me
Panthera power mixed with pouncy cute fun
Ruby roo roo roos under the sun
B B B or B that's my secret code
Sneaky but sweet on this phonk road
GEM G shining bright in my eyes so wide
Daddy and me we got that G4 pride

[Pre-Chorus 1 - Building Bounce]
Be bop pop bot phonk beat in your step
Pouncy little puma no one does it like you yet
Ruby bo boo B B B or B
Ruby roo roo roos kanga didgerdoo free
G4 swagger glowing warm and bright
Panthera pouncy ready for the night

[Chorus 1 - Duet Harmonize]
Ruby bo boo! Ruby roo roo roos!
G4 swagger we own the groove
Panthera pouncy phonk ride so true
Side by side forever me and you
Ruby bo boo! With that G4 glow!
Ruby roo roo roos stealing the show!
Be bop pop bot sneaky but sweet
My daughter Ruby you make life complete

[Verse 2 - Corey Extended]
Pouncy punky puma jumping high and low
Side by daddy's side stealing every show
Kanga kangaroo hopping to the rhythm so true
Didgerdoo soul calling from deep inside you
GEM G Gemini double the shine you bring
Panthera grace in everything
B B B or B that's your playful sound
Ruby roo roo roos spinning round and round
Sneaky phonk panthera vibe in your walk
Pouncy energy in your talk
G4 mode shining bright in your smile
Making every moment feel worthwhile

[Verse 2.5 - Ruby Extended Response]
Daddy when we bounce I feel so alive
Pouncy puma energy helping me thrive
Panthera strong but sweet like pie
Ruby bo boo reaching for the sky
Kanga kangaroo hopping with you
Didgeridoo soul coming through
G4 swagger in my little heart
Never gonna stop never gonna part
B B B or B my secret beat
Ruby roo roo roos feeling the heat

[Pre-Chorus 2 - Bigger Energy]
Be bop pop bot feel the phonk rise
Pouncy punky puma open your eyes
Ruby bo boo B B B or B
Ruby roo roo roos wild and free
G4 swagger joyful and proud
Panthera pouncy family loud

[Chorus 2 - Duet Bigger]
Ruby bo boo! Ruby roo roo roos!
G4 swagger we own the groove
Panthera pouncy phonk ride so true
Side by side forever me and you
Ruby bo boo! With that G4 glow!
Ruby roo roo roos stealing the show!
Be bop pop bot sneaky but sweet
My daughter Ruby you make life complete

[Bridge 1 - Soul Crawl + Spanish Lick Extended]
Didgeridoo soul crawl slow it down for my girl
Ruby roo feeling the ancient swirl
GEM G Gemini double the light you bring
G4 mode shining let your spirit sing
¡Mi Ruby mi gemita pantera pouncy G4!
Mi corazón te ama más y más
Soul deep connection feels so right
Panthera pouncy in the moonlight
Didgeridoo calling from the earth below
Ruby bo boo let your true colors show
B B B or B in the quiet space
Ruby roo roo roos full of grace
G4 swagger in the soul crawl deep
Father and daughter secrets we keep

[Breakdown - Pouncy Panthera Energy]
Pouncy punky puma bounce boun
